name: Recreus Filaflex 95A Foamy

retraction.note: Recreus's print parameters for Foamy (checked 21 October 2026): 2.5-5.0 mm at 65 mm/s, 0.2 mm z-hop, travel as fast as the printer allows. 4 mm on every travel, however short (min_travel 0), pushed back 4.2 mm (restart_extra 0.2): the best of the six swatches of tools/export-retraction-test.mjs printed on the MK3S (D; 3, 4 and 5 mm, each with no extra and 0.2 mm). Before it, 2.5 out and 2.5 back started thin for the first 6 cm, and 6 out and 7 back left a blob at every start.

notes: Dry at 55 C for at least 1 h. Direct-drive extruder recommended. Foams at 245-250 C; lower flow and higher temperature foam more.
